runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of the memorandum. It also applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that same 180-day date.

The trigger is the solicitation date, not the award date. A contract awarded later but solicited before the 180-day mark would not be covered under this provision.

Two related points from the passages:
- The memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
- The consolidated table of required actions also lists 180 days for each agency to achieve full compliance with the guidance of the memorandum.

The predecessor memo, M-24-18, used the same 180-day rule for contracts awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after 180 days after its issuance.
